newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SIA plans Oct ex-Brussels Australia/NZ rate rise.
newsitem.headline: SIA plans Oct ex-Brussels Australia/NZ rate rise.

text.p: Singapore Airlines said it planned to introduce a five percent increase in cargo rates to Australia/New Zealand from Brussels, effective October 1.
"While we've yet to finalise our plans on ex-Brussels increases, we expect to raise them by about five percent on routes to Australia and New Zealand," an SIA cargo official told Reuters.
There was little scope for increasing rates on its premium service to Singapore because these were already at an acceptable level, the official said.

SIA had no plans to change its current programme of two Boeing 747-400F and two 747-400 passenger flights each week from Brussels to Singapore with the introducton of winter schedules, the official added --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
